name: carbachol
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE: Intraocular use for obtaining miosis during surgery. In addition, MIOSTAT* (carbachol intraocular solution, USP) 0.01% reduces the intensity of IOP elevation in the first 24 hours after cataract surgery.
pediatric: Pediatric Use: Safety and efficacy in pediatric patients have not been established.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS: Should not be used in those persons showing hypersensitivity to any of the components of this preparation.
